name: brighty-agent-toolkit
description: Brighty banking and payments for AI agents — open accounts, run mass payouts, issue cards, and pay invoices through natural language. Ships an MCP server plus skills that teach the agent how to use it.

scripts.validate: npx -y skills-ref validate skills/brighty-banking && npx -y skills-ref validate skills/brighty-payouts && npx -y skills-ref validate skills/brighty-invoice-pay && npx -y skills-ref validate skills/brighty-cards
scripts.version: changeset version && node scripts/sync-versions.mjs && yarn format
